OMBA Singletrack Social

Fort Collins, CO · Mountain bike

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

OMBA Singletrack Social is a mountain bike group ride in Fort Collins, CO. Schedule: Wednesday evenings, March through August; time and trailhead vary. Pace: casual, ability groups with a sweep. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, ability groups with a sweep. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the OMBA Singletrack Social group ride

A casual Wednesday trail ride from the local mountain bike association. Riders split into ability groups, someone sweeps, and nobody gets dropped. Cancelled when trails are muddy. Details on the OMBA calendar and Facebook.
